popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Son of Tithonus and Eos, brother of Memnon; Heracles slays him in Arabia on the way to the Hesperides — Ethiopian lord of the Dawn's house.

popCulture.title: Emathion
popCulture.description: Ethiopian son of Tithonus and Eos — distinct from other mythic Emathions of the same name.
